items.title: Anthropic 限制 Claude 用于视频游戏逆向工程与克隆
items.summary: Anthropic 的 Claude 模型开始限制涉及视频游戏代码反编译、模组制作和逆向工程的任务。由于限制范围较宽，部分合法开发者的基础排查任务也受到了影响。

evidence.quote: Anthropic takes steps to block Claude from reverse-engineering video games
The restrictions are so broad that they're even hurting legitimate game developers and preventing basic troubleshooting tasks.

According to reporting from Tom's Hardware , Anthropic's Claude AI has quietly started restricting the kinds of work it will do, including modding, decompiling, or reverse-engineering video game code.

items.title: Opera 推出 WebAI 提案，支持在浏览器中直接运行本地 AI 模型
items.summary: Opera 推出了 WebAI 提案，允许网站和浏览器扩展在浏览器中直接运行本地 AI 模型，无需依赖云端服务器，目前已在 Opera One、Opera GX 和 Opera Neon 的早期预览版中上线。

bAI, a feature that allows websites and browser extensions to run AI models directly within the browser , without relying on cloud servers.

items.title: 新型 VOLTA 信息窃取木马利用 LLM 对受害者资产进行价值排序
items.summary: 研究发现 VOLTA 木马在窃取凭证和会话后，会调用 LLM 对受害者的资产和数据进行分析并按货币化价值排序，作为操作员的智能分析师。

evidence.quote: Appraisal by AI: Model-driven victim prioritization in the VOLTA infostealer
VOLTA is a mature stealer implant with an optional AI-integration layer.
After stealing credentials, sessions, and cryptocurrency wallets, VOLTA sends a structured evidence bundle to an LLM to rank the victim’s assets by monetization value.

items.title: 微软开源 Mage-VL-Cowork：4B 混合计算机视觉代理模型
items.summary: 微软开源了 Mage-VL-Cowork，这是一个 4B 视觉语言模型，专为混合计算机使用设计。该模型在 OSWorld-Verified 评测中达到 66.0% 的准确率，并通过端到端训练和在线强化学习降低了模型调用次数和输出 token 量。

At 4B parameters , Mage-VL-Cowork reaches 66.0% on OSWorld-Verified under a 50-step budget — achieving the best performance among 4B models and demonstrating that an efficient small VLM can excel at complex computer use , pushing the frontier of on-device intelligence .
Across training stages, online reinforcement learning adds +10.16 percentage points over Hybrid SFT while simultaneously cutting mean model calls by 13.0% and output tokens by 25.4% .

items.title: 百度开源 Unlimited-OCR-2，实现无限视野文档解析
items.summary: 百度开源了 Unlimited-OCR-2 模型，引入稀疏参考滑动窗口注意力（SR-SWA）机制，将超长序列的注意力交互压缩至固定大小的工作引用，从而消除了二次方注意力缩放瓶颈，支持长达上百页的超长文档解析。

evidence.quote: baidu / Unlimited-OCR-2 Like 479 Follow BAIDU 4.18k Image-Text-to-Text Transformers Safetensors multilingual unlimited-ocr feature-extraction baidu vision-language ocr custom_code arxiv: 2606.23050 License: mit Model card Files Files and versions xet Community 4 Deploy Copy to bucket Use this model
[2026/10/27] 🚀 We release Unlimited OCR 2 , achieving unlimited-horizon parsing with SR-SWA.
Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention (SR-SWA): Compresses text-visual attention interactions from ultra-long sequences down to a fixed-size set of working references (e.g., 512 tokens).

From Long- to Unlimited-Horizon Parsing: Powered by SR-SWA, Unlimited-OCR 2 achieves true, unbounded document parsing within a finite context window—effectively eliminating quadratic attention scaling and memory bottlenecks as documents grow.
